messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — I'm going to open a small PR to flip the client-side compat flag for structured output/function-calling to an opt-in 5% audience. planning to coordinate fallback behavior and metrics.

sam: ok good. what's the flag name on the client and server side?

maya: client: `client.compat.structured_output` (SDK). server: `redwood.so_enable` (feature flag in config). client default stays false.

devon: please add a clear rollback path. guardrail: if parser failures > 0.5% for 10m, auto-disable client sampling and notify SRE. also add a fallback route to the legacy `text_render` behavior.

maya: plan: 1) PR with client opt-in sampling (5%) + telemetry 2) enable server flag for canary audience so we can flip centrally if needed 3) smoke checks & eval prompt set run during first hour 4) rollback criteria + playbook.

sam: ping me for PR review. also request these metrics: `so.parse_failure_count`, `so.parse_failure_rate`, `so.p95_latency`, and `so.success_rate_by_model`.

ci-bot: Pipeline passed: 3/3 checks. :white_check_mark: (unit + lint + basic integration)

ruth: I'll coordinate an async QA slot tomorrow with SDK owners and docs. need to make the SDK behavior explicit: when `client.compat.structured_output=false` the SDK must not attempt function calling and should surface the raw text. when true, SDK attempts parse + emit structured payload and fallback if parse fails.

maya: agreed. I'll add a short example in README and a code snippet for the rollback case: 
```bash
# disable server-side quickly
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://flags.internal/api/set -d '{"flag":"redwood.so_enable","value":false}'
```

sam: one more ask — add alert which auto-triggers a runbook that can flip `redwood.so_enable` to false. that way product owners can quickly cut the feature without a full deploy.

devon: added a draft runbook in ops/playbooks/so-rollout.md (will link in PR). includes the curl above + who to page.

maya: nice. I'll reference the runbook in the PR description and the rollout doc. adding a short canary checklist: smoke evals, parse failure < threshold, latency regression < 10% vs baseline, no increase in 5xx.

sam: sounds good. also add a health-check endpoint check for the SDK integration (a small harness that sends the eval prompt set).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for 5% audience (client sampling + server gating) — initiated by @maya at ts=1764456900.

maya: watching logs now. will post results in this thread. thanks all for quick sync :thumbsup:

sam: thanks — i'll stand by for PR link.

maya: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/sdk/pulls/487 (tags: @sam @devon @ruth). added CHANGELOG entry and rollout checklist.

ci-bot: Integration tests ran against canary config: 78/78 passed.

maya: results so far: small bump in p95 for large contexts (~6%) but parse failure at 0.08% — within guardrail. continuing to watch for 30m.

sam: great. if anything crosses thresholds we flip server flag and revert client sampling.

devon: added an automated job to record sample payloads (sanitized) for a week so we can audit regressions.

maya: linking runbook + docs in PR now. will update thread after 30m.

ruth: thanks — once we clear QA we'll increase audience to 20% next week and repeat.

maya: ack. will update.

sam: LGTM for rollout plan, will review PR in-line.

maya: thanks everyone.
